question: What separates a project risk from a product risk in testing? Give an example of each.
key_points: project risks concern managing the project: people, time, budget, environment
product risks concern the quality of the software itself
e.g. the only tester falls sick or the staging server is down is a project risk
e.g. wrong interest calculation or a crash under heavy load is a product risk

question: How do you calculate cyclomatic complexity from a control flow graph, what quick shortcut can be used, and what value range counts as acceptable code?
key_points: CC = L - N + 2 (links minus nodes plus two)
shortcut: number of decision points plus one, or enclosed areas plus one
good code has CC between 1 and 10

question: Với yêu cầu 10 ≤ x ≤ 20, phân tích giá trị biên kiểu 3 giá trị cần chọn những giá trị nào? Kiểu 2 giá trị khác ở đâu?
expected_sources: software-tesing-ISYS2092-SYS3397/Chapter 4 - Testing Techniques/02 - Black-Box - Specification-Based Testing.md
key_points: three-value BVA: 9, 10, 11 and 19, 20, 21
two-value BVA: 9, 10 and 20, 21
BVA assumes most defects sit at the boundaries

question: Why is white-box testing unable to reveal a requirement that was never implemented, and what does reaching 100% statement coverage actually mean?
key_points: white-box tests are derived from the existing code structure, not the requirements specification
so missing implementation cannot be detected
100% statement coverage means every statement, including faulty ones, was executed at least once
decision coverage additionally needs every outcome (true and false) of each decision

question: Test charter của một phiên kiểm thử thăm dò gồm những mục nào, và khi nào kiểm thử thăm dò là lựa chọn phù hợp?
expected_sources: software-tesing-ISYS2092-SYS3397/Chapter 4 - Testing Techniques/05 - Experience - Based- Testing.md
key_points: charter covers what, what not, why, how, expected problems and references
learning, test design and test execution happen at the same time
fits when specifications are missing, there is no time to script, fast feedback is needed or the project is agile

question: Deviation hypothesis là gì, và một giả thuyết được viết tốt cần có những thành phần nào?
key_points: a structured prediction, written before testing, that the code deviates from a specific requirement (FR)
it is only a suspicion, not yet a defect
it names the violated FR, describes the deviation precisely and states the test that will verify it
if the test fails the hypothesis becomes a defect

question: When I move a standard test case into QAlity's limited fields, where should the prerequisites, test data and post-conditions go?
key_points: test case ID and title go into the Summary field
prerequisites and test data go into the Description field
steps and expected results go into Test Steps
post-conditions and notes go into Comments

question: Vì sao bài lab bắt dùng cả QAlity lẫn Katalon? Hai công cụ khác nhau thế nào?
key_points: QAlity is a test management tool in Jira for manual testing and recording results
Katalon automates test scripts
not everything can be automated
QAlity covers planning, manual results and traceability from story to test case to bug

question: Khi một test case bị fail, phần ghi nhận kết quả cần có những thông tin gì?
key_points: status Failed with expected and actual results
a screenshot of the error
environment information such as browser and network
the test data used, the bug ID and the time

question: When should Katalon's self-healing be switched off, and how can I tell that a test passed only because self-healing stepped in?
expected_sources: software-tesing-ISYS2092-SYS3397/Tutorial 1 - Get To Know Katalon/Katalon Self Healing.md
key_points: turn it off while writing or debugging scripts so failures show immediately
turn it on for unattended runs such as CI or overnight suites
the log shows Passed together with an orange warning
configured under Project > Settings > Execution > Self-healing > Web UI

question: Trong Katalon Studio, thư mục Object Repository và Profiles dùng để lưu gì?
expected_sources: software-tesing-ISYS2092-SYS3397/Tutorial 1 - Get To Know Katalon/Overview Katalon interface.md
key_points: Object Repository stores the identities of UI elements so they can be reused
Profiles store environment variables such as URL and credentials per environment
Test Suites group several test cases to run together
